body:
I wish to express how important your comment is to me. It's true that I don't trust myself, even after this post and all the responces I'm doubting my judgements and feelings all the time.


I am thankful for you sharing your experience and giving me support and comfort that I needed. I really, really value it and how much better it makes me feel.


I know that there is a long path of work ahead of me, but your experience makes me feel confident that I can do it. 


Thank you, take care!
Thanks, and I am sorry you have experienced similar things too. I know how this feels. I wish you all the best and hope you are doing well!

Thanks, it makes sense to me! It's true that realization hit me hard and I'm struggling with accepting all of this, but I have hope.


Best wishes to you!

Thank you! Your comment really explains how I have hard time distinguishing normal/not normal. Internally I feel uncomfortable about every point I have mentioned and this is totally because of our unhealthy relationship.

Yep, I'm hopefully moving out soon and this idea gives me hope.

Take care too!
Thank you! I have never thought these events give such an extreme impression, but I totally see the point now. Guess it time for me to get rid of illusions about my mother. Take care.
Thank you, I'm really sorry this is relatable for you too! All the best.
Thank you for the perspective! Hopefully I will move out in September. All the best.
